stem: An open box is made from a rectangular sheet of cardboard 20 centimeters long and 14 centimeters wide by cutting a square with side length \(x\) centimeters from each corner and folding up the sides. The base of the box has an area of 160 square centimeters. What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: After the cuts, the base measures \((20 - 2x)\) by \((14 - 2x)\) centimeters.
A cut of 15 centimeters is impossible, since \(14 - 2(15) < 0\). So \(x = 2\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
sols = solve(Eq((20 - 2*x)*(14 - 2*x), 160), x)
assert sorted(sols) == [2, 15]
ok = [s for s in sols if 0 < s and 14 - 2*s > 0]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == ok
